name: Kanban
descriptor: A board of columns from one select field. Status at a glance, and one move per card.
pros: the state of everything is visible at once, without reading rows
moving a card is one button, not an edit form
the column counts are the summary, so no separate stats are needed
it degrades to a scrolling row of columns on a phone
cons: no drag and drop: two buttons per card instead
columns come from a select field, so adding a stage means editing the spec
past four or five columns it wants a wide screen
best_for: work that moves through a handful of named stages
avoid_if: the order within a column matters, or stages need rules
